subject: SolidGeometry

visibility.notes: Analytically frozen for the declared model and view; no generic occlusion assumption.

objects.semantic_fill_reason: Rectangular front material with a clockwise circular hole path; no white masking.

solid_model.description: Rectangular prism minus a full through-bore perpendicular to its front rectangular face.
solid_model.visibility_derivation: Ray intersections with every finite analytic surface and clipping plane are sorted. Positive open ray intervals are tested against the union-minus-subtraction material domain. Boundary curves are partitioned at isolated visibility transitions refined by 40 bisections; all frozen intervals are explicitly stored and sampled separately. No raster hand tracing or draw-order occlusion is used.
